MOVE.summary: Moves a namespace to a new hierarchical path.
MOVE.complexity: O(D) where D is the depth of the deeper of the two paths.

arguments.name: old-namespace
arguments.summary: Dot-separated hierarchical path of the source namespace, for example staging.orders.

arguments.name: new-namespace
arguments.summary: Dot-separated hierarchical path of the destination namespace, for example production.orders.
